# Kassel Technology

> Malaysia's rising industrial automation and control systems integration partner. Specializing in high-efficiency PLC, HMI, SCADA programming, control panel design, and 24/7 emergency breakdown diagnostics.

## Services

- **PLC, HMI, & SCADA Design**: Custom programming and control system architecture using Siemens TIA Portal, Allen Bradley Studio 5000, Mitsubishi GX Works, and Omron CX-One/Sysmac Studio.
- **Control Panel Wiring**: Custom cabinet design and electrical panel fabrication for SPM machines, conveyor networks, and pump house systems.
- **Breakdown & Troubleshooting**: 24/7 rapid response diagnostics for factory machinery, automation lines, and PLC controller faults across Malaysia.
- **Technical Trainings**: Practical-oriented corporate training courses for PLC programming and HMI configuration.
